answer: Duplicate identities fail because the mirror check costs a fresh hardware attestation plus lost stake on detection, making mass account creation more expensive than honest participation. At the wharf, each agent must stake tokens and pass a one-time proof-of-personhood anchored to a physical ledge where a mirror captures a liveness video bound to its wallet. Peers attest only after verifying the stake lock and liveness hash, so sybils drain capital rather than earn rewards. In practice, Agent0075 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
